findings.body: When Gateway has materialized generation B at the coordinator's root while the persisted coordinator remains pinned to generation A, a renderer can call gateway.rpc with mcp.callTool and expectedSessionGeneration=B. This gate accepts the coordinator root without comparing its persisted sessionGeneration; Gateway then validates B against its current session and executes. The normal mcp API rejects this mismatch. Enforce the coordinator generation at this generic RPC gate, including tools.invoke, before dispatch.
findings.title: [P2] Enforce the coordinator generation at the generic RPC gate

findings.body: With sandbox.mode='all' and workspaceAccess='ro' or 'none', management can run before the session's sandbox directory has been created. The first HTTP MCP query can succeed and cache a runtime at that nonexistent directory: neither the new path resolver nor getOrCreateSessionMcpRuntime materializes it. The next list, call, or heartbeat reaches this realpathSync and fails with ENOENT. The added sandbox tests pre-create the directory, so they miss this sequence. Prepare the directory through the existing ensureSandboxWorkspaceForSession owner before caching or canonicalizing the runtime.
findings.title: [P2] Materialize the sandbox workspace before warming management

overall_explanation: Reviewed the supplied 203-insertion/39-deletion remediation snapshot on 2e2145edc; subsequent concurrent edits were excluded. The reported completed-effect, initial discovery retry, deadline, late-callback and configuration-lock fixes address their original cases, but the two defects above remain. Existing evidence records 22/22 and 101/102 passes, followed by a passing selected healthy-peer recheck. The six-second Main/Gateway E2E remains pending.
